description: Core worker logic: rewrite auction clearing (Task 2), physics v2 audit with hash chain (Task 3), escrow state machine (Task 5), Form-1 PDF pipeline (Task 6), and GSTIN privacy scrubbing in all agent runners (Task 7 application). Depends on FEAT-001 (hash_chain.py, privacy.py, ORM columns, migrations). Independent of FEAT-003.
steps: 1. [Task 2] Rewrite execute_double_auction_activity in worker/src/activities/agent_activities.py. New signature adds: org_id: str = '', auction_id: str = '', corridor_min: float = 0.0, corridor_max: float = 0.0. Body: fetch BidRecord rows from DB for auction_id ordered by price_per_kg DESC. If no rows, fall back to run_treasury_agent(). Uniform-price clearing: walk sorted bids accumulating volume until >= target_tons; clearing_price = last accepted bid price_per_kg; clamp to [corridor_min, corridor_max] if non-zero. Update AuctionRecord (status='CLEARED', clearing_price_inr, total_cleared_tons) and accepted BidRecords (status='ACCEPTED') in DB. Return AuctionResult(clearing_price, winner_org_id, total_volume_tons).

2. [Task 3] Add chain_head: str = '' to AuditResult in worker/src/activities/agent_activities.py. Update audit_scada_telemetry_activity signature to add sec_baseline: float = 450.0, sec_variance: float = 30.0. Body changes: after running run_auditor_agent(), extract energy_total_kwh and mass_total_kg from result (keys 'energy_total_kwh' and 'mass_total_kg'; if missing default to 0). If energy_total_kwh == 0 raise ApplicationError('FAIL_CLOSED: zero energy total', non_retryable=False). Compute sec_actual = energy_total_kwh / mass_total_kg * 1000. band_upper = sec_baseline + 3 * sec_variance. claimed_mass = reported_volume_tons * 1000 (convert tons to kg). delta = abs(claimed_mass - mass_total_kg) / claimed_mass. Deterministic verdict: if sec_actual > band_upper: verdict='HITL'; elif delta > delta_threshold/100: verdict='HITL'; else verdict='PASS'. Build HashChain from services.hash_chain, create one TelemetryFrame per reading if frames available (or a single synthetic frame from totals), append each, store chain.head. Set result['chain_head'] = chain.head. Override result['verdict'] with deterministic verdict.

3. [Task 3 workflow] In worker/src/flows/workflows.py Stage 3b (MasterEPRComplianceWorkflow): before the audit_scada_telemetry_activity call, add guard: if not run_config.calibrations: raise ApplicationError('FAIL_CLOSED: no calibrations found', non_retryable=True). Add sec_baseline=run_config.calibrations[0].sec_baseline_kwh_per_ton and sec_variance=run_config.calibrations[0].sec_variance to the args list.

4. [Task 5] Update create_escrow_split_po_activity in worker/src/activities/agent_activities.py: add params escrow_split_primary: float = 0.8, escrow_split_holdback: float = 0.2. After run_erp_agent() call, compute total_value = plastic_tons * unit_price_inr * 1000 (tons to kg). advance_amount = total_value * escrow_split_primary. holdback_amount = total_value * escrow_split_holdback. Upsert or update EscrowPORecord in DB using po_number from result, setting advance_amount, holdback_amount, escrow_status='advance_pending'. Add advance_amount: float = 0.0 and holdback_amount: float = 0.0 to POResult. Update Stage 4 in workflows.py to pass escrow_split_primary=run_config.pack.escrow_split_primary, escrow_split_holdback=run_config.pack.escrow_split_holdback.

5. [Task 6] Add reportlab>=4.2.0 to worker/pyproject.toml dependencies. Create worker/src/reporting/__init__.py (empty). Create worker/src/reporting/form1_schema.py with Form1Data(BaseModel): org_name: str, fiscal_year: str, category: str, volume_tons: float, compliance_pct: float, audit_id: str, po_reference: str, chain_head: str, generated_date: str, is_signed: bool = False. Create worker/src/reporting/pdf_generator.py with generate_form1_pdf(data: Form1Data) -> bytes using reportlab: A4 page, SimpleDocTemplate, table with org name/fiscal year/category/volumes/compliance %/audit_id/PO reference/chain_head[:16]+'...'/generated_date. DRAFT watermark if not data.is_signed (draw diagonal grey text at 45 degrees using canvas.saveState/rotate/drawString/restoreState). Update generate_and_dispatch_form1_activity: after run_legal_agent(), build Form1Data, call generate_form1_pdf(), write bytes to /tmp/form1_{form1_id}.pdf, force result['portal_status'] = 'READY_FOR_MANUAL_UPLOAD', add pdf_path: str = '' to Form1Result, set result['pdf_path'] = pdf_path.

6. [Task 7 application] In each of the 7 agent runner files (treasury_agent.py, legal_agent.py, logistics_agent.py, auditor_agent.py, regulatory_agent.py, brand_liability_agent.py, erp_agent.py): add 'from agents.privacy import scrub' import. In the run_*_agent() function, before calling run_agent(), apply scrub() to the user_message string. Add org_id: str = '' parameter to each runner if not already present.

cd worker && python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); from reporting.pdf_generator import generate_form1_pdf; from reporting.form1_schema import Form1Data; print('ok')" prints ok
AuditResult has chain_head field; POResult has advance_amount and holdback_amount fields; Form1Result has pdf_path field
All 7 agent runners import and call scrub() on their user_message before run_agent()

findings: All tasks implemented as specified. Verifications 1 and 2 pass cleanly. Verification 3 (pytest) collected 2 items: test_privacy.py (2 tests, PASS) and test_worker.py (collection error). test_worker.py was already failing before FEAT-002 — it requires scikit-learn/numpy from the full worker ML runtime stack (jev_auditor.py top-level imports) which are unavailable in this environment. FEAT-001 findings noted the same environment constraint. conftest.py was updated to add both worker root and src/ to sys.path (fixing the import path issue introduced by flows/__init__.py eager loading). Deviation from spec: generate_and_dispatch_form1_activity signature extended with chain_head, org_name, fiscal_year, category, compliance_pct optional params to build Form1Data without requiring callers to change (all have defaults). Stage 4 workflow args pass None for audit_verdict/human_approved positional slots (which are not yet wired to the master workflow's HITL result — the caller will need to pass those explicitly in production).
